opportunities.title: Reader Gallery Print: The Quiet Corner Composition
opportunities.audience: Book lovers seeking quiet, non-fandom decor for reading nooks; occasion: home office or library shelf styling.
opportunities.concept: A gallery print featuring a stylized illustration of a cat-librarian in a reading corner with custom book spines (no copyrighted titles), framed as a cohesive art piece rather than generic wall art. Fulfillment relies on Printify posters for feasible production and shipping, avoiding embroidery or sweatshirts which lack demand evidence.
opportunities.nextStep: Check 'reader gallery print' searches/listings and period; quote Printify poster base price plus shipping to US destination; subtract Etsy/payment/listing fees.

opportunities.title: Personalized Pet Watercolor Ornament: Bold Name System
opportunities.audience: Pet owners gifting holiday or birthday ornaments; occasion: personalized pet memorial or celebration.
opportunities.concept: A personalized ceramic ornament featuring a bold, high-contrast watercolor portrait of the pet with their name integrated into the design to meet Printify's small print area guidelines. Fulfillment requires per-order artwork creation and proof handling before production.
opportunities.nextStep: Check 'personalized pet ornament' searches/listings and period; quote Printify ceramic ornament base price plus shipping to US destination; subtract Etsy/payment/listing fees.

opportunities.title: Nonpersonalized Bookish Cat DTG Crewneck: Library Iconography
opportunities.audience: General readers and cat lovers seeking casual wear; occasion: everyday comfort or book club meetups.
opportunities.concept: A nonpersonalized crewneck sweatshirt featuring a stylized, original illustration of a cat surrounded by open books (no specific titles or logos), printed via DTG to allow for complex imagery. Fulfillment relies on Printify Gildan 18000 catalog starting prices.
opportunities.nextStep: Check 'bookish cat sweatshirt' searches/listings and period; quote Printify Gildan 18000 US size M starting price plus shipping to US destination; subtract Etsy/payment/listing fees.

opportunities.evidence:
Etsy · Spring and Summer 2026 trend report — Data as of 2026-02-10; recent three months versus prior year; published 2026-03-17. Gallery prints +80% and wall-art decor +110% are broad category search signals. They do not establish current demand for reader-specific illustrations or profitable prints. No exact product search volume, item sales or conversion is supplied.

Printify · Custom posters — Saved general product-family information; no selected supplier quote. Print-on-demand framed and unframed posters are feasible product families. This page establishes supply only, not demand, shipping cost, variant margin or a reason to prefer wall art over other products.

opportunities.evidence:
Etsy · Personalized pet watercolor ornament, ModPawsUS — Retrieved public page snapshot; visible review examples from 2025 and January 2026. Six item reviews, 4.7 item rating. Photo/name customization requires per-order artwork and proofs. Shop sales are not item sales. No current item sales volume or profit is available; snapshot may be cached/localized.

Printify · Ceramic ornament design guidelines — Guidance retrieved 2026-10-30; selected product template still required. Small print area needs bold text/lines and safe-area placement. Tiny details and pale gradients risk poor reproduction. Guidance is production feasibility evidence, not buyer demand or an exact template.

Embroidery differs from a DTG printed product. Shop totals and offer prices cannot establish this item's sales, conversion or profitability. Snapshot may be cached/localized.

Printify · Gildan 18000 crewneck catalog — Public starting-price snapshot; actual selected account quote unavailable. US Printify Choice DTG catalog starts at USD 17.87 plus shipping from USD 7.39. These are starting estimates, not a selected variant/provider quote or verified contribution. Account prices, destination, print area and availability must be checked before preparing a listing.

limitations: Analysis of saved evidence only; no live Etsy or competitor data was collected.
Concepts and suggested keywords are model proposals, not verified market facts.
Exact-product demand, supplier variant quotes, shipping, fees and margins remain unverified.
